title: Total weight of coordinate restrictions
statement: Let $\\iota$ be a finite set, and assign to each coordinate restriction one of the weights $\\delta$ for a free coordinate and $(1-\\delta)/2$ for either fixed sign, for any real $\\delta$. The sum, over all assignments of restrictions to the coordinates in $\\iota$, of the product of their coordinate weights is $1$.
